answer_1.quote: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across various generative tasks, such as text creation, dialogue generation, and content summarization.

answer_2.quote: We employed a comprehensive set of metrics to evaluate the performance of DioR and other RAG methods on different datasets and retrieval methods. These metrics can be broadly categorized into two groups: effectiveness metrics and efficiency metrics. Effectiveness metrics aimed to measure the accuracy and quality of the generated answers. We evaluated the models using Exact Match (EM), F1 Score, Precision (Pre.), and Recall (Rec.). ... Efficiency metrics ... Retrieve Count (Rc) ... Generate Count (Gc) ... Hallucinated Count (Hc) ... Token Count (Tc) and Sentence Count (Sc).
